name: Summer Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Summer Youth Volunteer Program. Volunteer at a VA facility as an individual or a group.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18 (18-year-olds must be enrolled in high school). Based on the 2024 flyer; check the current year's rules.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Free to join; volunteers over 100 hours can be considered for scholarships through community partners (2024 flyer).
duration: 6 weeks, Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. (2024: June 17 to July 26)
deadline_text: The VA page says applications for the 2026 program closed April 24, 2026. The 2024 deadline was April 30. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: 2024 flyer: application with parent signature, a 1-page essay, an availability schedule, and a virtual orientation. Contact the VA Center for Development and Civic Engagement, vhalomyouthprogram@va.gov.
notes: Closed now. The age, hours and application steps come from the 2024 flyer because the current page only says 2026 applications are closed. The 2024 flyer also required COVID vaccination or an exemption; check the current policy.
